summary: This project is an open‑source business card that harvests NFC energy to power an onboard MCU, enabling low‑power contactless interactions. It is built as a custom PCB with firmware that must be flashed manually, and the design files are hosted on GitHub. The card targets makers and IoT enthusiasts who want a self‑powered NFC device without external power sources. Reviewers praised its engineering creativity (7/10 sentiment, 193 HN points) but noted concerns about cost and practical deployment, and the limited test coverage suggests modest ease of use.
